title: One message, many channels

captions.instagram:
Can a customer repeat your brand promise in five words? If not, your channels are probably saying different things.

How I'd fix it: say one thing, say it everywhere, show it in the store, and change the offers, not the identity.

Save the 5-point message check.

#Branding #Marketing #SmallBusiness

What's your brand promise in five words?
captions.facebook:
One promise. Every channel. I put together a 5-point check to see whether your ads, signs, posts and store all say the same thing.

#Branding #SmallBusiness

Could your customers repeat your promise?
captions.linkedin:
If customers can't summarize you, your channels are probably saying different things.

My rule for consistency: pick one promise customers can repeat, match every sign, ad and post to it, make the in-store experience deliver it, and change offers without changing identity.

The check I'd run: Can a customer repeat our promise? Do all channels use it? Does the store deliver it? Is the look consistent? When did we last review it?

#Branding #Marketing

When did you last audit your message?
